info.name: Employee Onboarding | JSONPlaceholder Mock API Lab
info.description: Training-only GET and POST requests. Fake API, not production onboarding. POST does not persist data.

request.description: Public mock user list, no real employee data.

exec: pm.test("GET returns a nonempty array", function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; });

request.description: Training mock. Response echoes synthetic request fields; no persistence or real validation.

exec: pm.test("Employee name matches request", function () { const r=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.name).to.eql("Jordan Smith"); });
pm.test("Employee email matches request", function () { const r=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.email).to.eql("jordan.smith@example.com"); });
pm.test("Employee ID is returned", function () { const r=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r).to.have.property("id"); });
